statements.status_notes: CVE-2024-26461 is a memory leak in gss_krb5int_make_seal_token_v3() in the krb5 GSS-API mechanism (src/lib/gssapi/krb5/k5sealv3.c): one bounds-check error path returns without freeing the plaintext buffer. MIT fixed it in commit https://github.com/krb5/krb5/commit/c5f9c816107f70139de11b38aa02db2f1774ee0d, first released in krb5 1.22, whose message says that check could probably never be triggered. Debian marks trixie's 1.21.3-5+deb13u1 vulnerable, with urgency unimportant (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2024-26461). This owner is built from that Debian version; the MIT 1.21.3 source of k5sealv3.c lacks the change, and neither Debian's patches nor this owner's backports touch that file, so every matched build carries the leak. Pending: a decision whether to backport the upstream change or to record MIT's reasoning that the error path is unreachable; upstream's wording is not definitive, so a not-affected statement needs a recorded maintainer decision.
